feed.title: RealHunt: new homes
feed.subtitle: The newest homes on RealHunt, each checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.
feed.rights: Text and figures: CC BY 4.0, with a link. Photos belong to the original listings.

entry.title: €195,000 · Restored stone courtyard house with a sea-view roof terrace in Gytheio
entry.summary: Gytheio, Laconia. 85 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. A traditional stone house of 85 m2 on a quiet car-free lane in the old town of Gytheio, a short walk from the harbour front, on a 127 m2 walled plot. Restored with original stone paving, wooden floors and old doors kept. A stone-floored living room opens to the courtyard, where a newly renovated kitchen and an outdoor shower sit under a lemon tree. Upstairs are a double and a single bedroom and a modern shower room, and a raised terrace looks over the rooftops to the sea. Sold turnkey; Mavrovouni beach is 5 minutes by car.

entry.title: €210,000 · Renovated Luberon village house with vaulted cellar in Saint-Martin-de-Castillon
entry.summary: Saint-Martin-de-Castillon, Vaucluse, Provence. 90 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A fully renovated village house of about 90 m2 in the Luberon hills, priced near the low end of the portal's local sales range per m2. The fitted kitchen opens onto a vaulted stone cellar and a small terrace, the bright living room has a wood stove and open views, and there are two bedrooms, a modern shower room, two toilets and a utility room. The photos show beamed ceilings and new finishes throughout. Shops and the village swimming pool are about 400 metres away. Asking 210,000 euros.

entry.title: €175,000 · Single-storey 138 m² home with garden below the mountains in Zupci, near Bar
entry.summary: Zupci, Bar. 138 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. A single-storey home of 138 m² in Zupci, a quiet village in the hills behind the town of Bar, with steep mountains right behind it. Two bedrooms, a bathroom, a large open living and dining room with a fitted kitchen, a terrace and a balcony, with air conditioning, heating and parking. The photos show bright, tidy, furnished rooms and a lawned garden. Asking €175,000, about €1,270/m². The advert files it as an apartment, so ask whether the house and garden are shared.

entry.title: €205,000 · Stone house with a private riverbank and outbuildings in Vendeuvre, Normandy
entry.summary: Vendeuvre, Calvados, Normandy. 100 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 76. A 99.5 m2 stone house on an enclosed 1,545 m2 plot that runs down to a river with private banks. Downstairs are a living room with a wood-burning insert, a fitted kitchen and a bathroom, and upstairs three bedrooms of 13 to 15 m2. Double glazing, a recent air-to-water heat pump and solar panels are already in place, and the outbuildings add about 150 m2 with two garages, a workshop and a carport. The advert says some finishing and refreshing work is still to plan. Saint-Pierre-sur-Dives is a 7-minute drive. Property tax 647 euros a year.

entry.title: €195,000 · Renovated village house with its own pool in Benijófar, Costa Blanca
entry.summary: Benijófar, Alicante. 66 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 76. A single-storey house in the centre of Benijófar, a small town in the Vega Baja inland from the southern Costa Blanca, renovated and described as move-in ready. About 66 m2, south facing, with an open living room and kitchen, two double bedrooms with high ceilings and wooden beams, and a modern shower room. The private walled yard holds a pool of about 18 m2 and a dining terrace, which is rare at this price. Shops, schools and health services are in the town. Community fees and yearly tax are not stated in the advert.

entry.title: €216,600 · Colonial house with a pool and garden in Barrio de Santiago, Mérida centre
entry.summary: Mérida, Yucatán. 160 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 86. Asking MX$4,450,000 (about €216,600) for Casa Ya'axche', a single-storey colonial house of 160 m² on a 279 m² plot in Barrio de Santiago, one of the old neighbourhoods of central Mérida. It keeps its stone walls, high ceilings and patterned cement tile floors. The living room, kitchen and dining area open onto a long swimming pool, and there are inner gardens with mature trees, a barbecue area and terrace. Both bedrooms have their own bathroom, air conditioning and fans, and there is a third bathroom by the patio, a covered parking space and a laundry room. The photos show it renovated and furnished.

entry.title: €124,000 · Freshly painted three-bedroom house with ocean views in Hillsburn, Nova Scotia
entry.summary: Hillsburn, Nova Scotia. 106 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 88. Asking C$194,900 (about €124,000) for a three-bedroom house of about 106 m² on a hillside plot in Hillsburn, a shore village on the Bay of Fundy about 10 minutes from Annapolis Royal. The aerial photos show the sea just below. It is move-in ready, with a freshly painted exterior and new windows. The main floor has a large country kitchen with an island, a dining room, a living room with a pellet stove and a sea view, and a big bathroom with soaker tub and walk-in shower. Upstairs are the three bedrooms and a storage room. Outside are raised garden beds, a shed, a deck and a viewing platform.

entry.title: €199,000 · Garden-level flat with a south terrace steps from the beach on the Flensburg Fjord
entry.summary: Wassersleben, Harrislee, Schleswig-Holstein. 60 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. A three-room flat of about 60 m² a few steps from the beach and the Flensburg Fjord. The living room with open kitchen has floor-to-ceiling windows onto a south-facing terrace that looks over a well kept communal garden. Two further rooms work as bedrooms or an office, and the bathroom has a tub. Electric outside blinds on every window, a step-free basement storage room for bikes and beach gear, and a parking space in front. It is empty and available soon. District heating, energy class C. Monthly building fees are not given in the advert.

entry.title: €165,200 · Fully remodelled three-bedroom house in a gated complex with pool, Santa Marta
entry.summary: Santa Marta, Magdalena. 120 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 86. Asking COP 590,000,000 (about €165,200) for a two-storey house of about 120 m² in a gated residential complex in Rodadero Reservado, the quiet area north of El Rodadero beach in Santa Marta on the Caribbean coast. It has just been fully remodelled in a modern style: a new kitchen with stone-look worktops and gas hob, glossy tiled floors, a steel-railed staircase and new bathrooms with glass showers. There are three bedrooms, the main one with its own bathroom and dressing area, a separate study and a guest toilet. Balconies look onto green hills, and the complex has a large shared pool. Maintenance fee not stated.

entry.title: €170,000 · Furnished two-bedroom flat with sea views in Nea Fokea, Kassandra, Halkidiki
entry.summary: Nea Fokea, Kassandra, Halkidiki. 60 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A 60 m2 first-floor flat in a two-storey building in Nea Fokea, a seaside village on the Kassandra peninsula of Halkidiki. The advert says the sea can be seen from the windows and that the owners will leave the furniture. Open living room with a modern fitted kitchen and wood stove, two bedrooms and a shower room, with windows on two sides and a covered balcony with awnings. Air conditioning, oil central heating with radiators and solar water heating. The photos show a well-kept home ready to use.

entry.title: €196,000 · Top-floor two-bedroom flat with private roof terrace in Cabo Blanco, Tenerife
entry.summary: Cabo Blanco, Arona, Tenerife. 82 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A bright 82 m2 flat on the top floor of a small block in Cabo Blanco, a local Canarian town about 10 minutes by car from the TF-1 and the south coast resorts of Los Cristianos. Open-plan living room and modern kitchen, two good bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, a bathroom with walk-in shower and a utility room. The best part is a private roof terrace behind its own gate, furnished with loungers and a table, with mountain views. Sold furnished and described as turnkey, with a supermarket, shops and bars close by. Community fees are not stated.

entry.title: €69,500 · Renovated townhouse with new kitchen and air conditioning in Masseube, Gers
entry.summary: Masseube, Gers. 70 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. A renovated 70 m² townhouse in Masseube for €69,500, under €1,000 per m², close to the shops and services. Downstairs a 25 m² living room opens to a fully fitted kitchen, with a storage room and WC. Upstairs are two bedrooms of 13 and 16 m², each with its own shower and basin. The roof was redone in 2013, the attic is insulated and there is reversible air conditioning. Connected to mains drainage. Energy rating C, good for an older house. The photos show fresh floors, a new kitchen and clean shower units. No garden is mentioned.

entry.title: €140,000 · Renovated period flat with vaulted ceilings in central Acqui Terme, Piedmont
entry.summary: Acqui Terme, Piedmont. 120 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. A second-floor flat of about 120 m2 in a period building in the centre of Acqui Terme, the Piedmont spa town known for its hot springs and wine country. The advert says it was completely renovated, keeping the vaulted ceilings and original marble fireplace, with new wooden floors throughout. Living room and kitchen divided by a corten steel wall, a large bedroom, a second connected bedroom or study, and a bathroom with tub. Three balconies, two over the street and one inside the courtyard. Independent gas heating. No lift, so stairs only. About 1,170 euros per m2.

entry.title: €152,100 · Three-bedroom house in a gated estate with pool and tennis in El Marqués, Querétaro
entry.summary: El Marqués, Querétaro. 146 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. Asking MX$3,125,000 (about €152,100) for a three-year-old two-storey house of about 146 m² in Alleza Mirador, a gated estate in El Marqués on the edge of Querétaro city. It has three bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a guest toilet, an open kitchen with island and stainless appliances, a laundry room, fitted wardrobes and a covered back terrace with skylights. Two cars park in front. The advert describes it as in excellent condition, and the photos show a tidy, modern home. Residents share a swimming pool, gym, tennis and padel courts, play area and barbecue spots. Maintenance fee not stated.

entry.title: €120,000 · Fully renovated townhouse with no community fees in Roquetes, near Tortosa
entry.summary: Raval de Crist, Roquetes, Tarragona. 82 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A 1920 townhouse in the quiet Raval de Crist area of Roquetes, next to Tortosa in southern Catalonia, completely renovated and ready to move into. 82 m2 of usable space on three floors: living room, dining room and fitted kitchen opening to a small walled patio, then a double and a single bedroom, a south-facing balcony and a bathroom with jetted tub, plus a semi-basement room for an office or gym with its own toilet. Beams and stone walls kept. Reversible air conditioning and fibre internet. The advert states zero community fees.

entry.title: €199,000 · Restored three-bed stone house with roof terrace in Kritsa village, Crete
entry.summary: Kritsa, Agios Nikolaos, Crete. 105 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. A restored stone house a short walk from the square of Kritsa, the largest village around Agios Nikolaos and 7 km from the town and sandy beaches. A plant-filled terrace under a pergola leads to a furnished roof terrace with views over the mountains, the village and the sea in the distance. Inside are wood-beamed ceilings, stone walls, a living room with a wood stove, a fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and three bathrooms. It is sold furnished and in very good condition. Car access is about 70 m away, with public parking 100 to 150 m away.

entry.title: €187,000 · Fully renovated two-bedroom townhouse with title deeds in Paralimni, Famagusta
entry.summary: Paralimni, Famagusta. 74 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. A two-bedroom townhouse in a quiet residential area of Paralimni, sold with title deeds and fully renovated. 74 m² inside plus an 11 m² front veranda and a 5 m² balcony with a partial sea view from the main bedroom. New kitchen with integrated dishwasher and oven, a guest WC, a bathroom with a walk-in shower, new air conditioning, upgraded fitted wardrobes and a new solar hot-water system. Allocated parking at the rear. The advert puts the nearest beach 10 minutes away. Sold unfurnished. Asking €187,000, about €2,530/m². Communal fees are not stated.

entry.title: €209,600 · Three-bedroom house with a big fenced yard near the Mississippi in Red Wing
entry.summary: Red Wing, Minnesota. 137 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 89. Asking US$230,000 (about €209,600) for a 1996 house of about 137 m² on a quiet dead-end street in Red Wing, a historic river town under wooded bluffs on the Mississippi. It has been freshly painted, with hardwood floors on the main level, where the three bedrooms, kitchen and an updated full bathroom are. The finished lower level adds a family room with a gas fireplace and a half bath. Outside there is a deck, a huge fenced back garden, a shed and an attached two-car garage. The aerial photos show the river and Colvill Park close by. Yearly property tax US$2,848, no HOA fee.

entry.title: €185,980 · Renovated top-floor flat facing the ocean and Teide in Mesa del Mar, Tenerife
entry.summary: Mesa del Mar, Tacoronte, Tenerife. 51 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. A one-bedroom flat on the tenth and top floor of a seafront building in Mesa del Mar on the north coast of Tenerife, next to the beach and natural sea pools. The photos show open ocean from the windows and Mount Teide from the bedroom. The advert says plumbing, wiring, bathroom and kitchen were recently renewed, and it is sold furnished. Lift access. The building is having its paintwork redone; the owner has already paid that charge. The communal pool is closed with no reopening date given. About 51 m2. Monthly community fees are not stated.

entry.title: €159,000 · Character 1888 house with harbour views and a koi pond garden in Pictou, Nova Scotia
entry.summary: Pictou, Nova Scotia. 171 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 87. Asking C$249,900 (about €159,000) for a white wooden house of about 171 m², built in 1888 in the preserved old town of Pictou, with views over the harbour and a short walk to downtown. The big costs are done: a newer metal roof, a propane furnace and some new plumbing. Inside are tall windows, wood floors, a fireplace, original crown mouldings and a curved staircase, with three bedrooms and one and a half bathrooms. The front veranda faces the street, and the back garden has a koi pond and a large barn. The kitchen is older but clean.

entry.title: €107,500 · Bright four-bedroom house from 2014 on Mukaishima island, Onomichi, Hiroshima
entry.summary: Mukaishima, Onomichi, Hiroshima. 104 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A two-storey wooden house built in January 2014 on Mukaishima, the island facing Onomichi across a narrow strait of the Seto Inland Sea. 103.5 m² with four bedrooms, a south-facing living, dining and kitchen room opening onto a tatami room, a walk-in wardrobe and a covered drying area, on a 183 m² freehold plot with parking for four cars. The house is empty and may also be used as a small office. Onomichi station is 5.4 km away, about 13 minutes by bus. Mains water reaches the plot through a neighbour's land. Asking ¥18,800,000 (about €107,500), roughly €1,040/m².

entry.title: €230,000 · Three-bed marina-view apartment with roof terrace and boat berth in Leitrim Village
entry.summary: Leitrim Village, County Leitrim. 121 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A 121 m² three-bedroom apartment for €230,000, sold fully furnished, with a private marina berth included. It faces south-east with open views over the marina, the Shannon-Erne Waterway and Sheemore Hill, from a large front balcony and a private roof terrace. The building has a lift and private parking, and the village shops, pubs and cafés are a short walk away. Gas central heating and a B energy rating. Photos show a bright living and dining room with big windows, a separate kitchen with island and tidy bathrooms. Service charge for 2026 is €2,022.95.

entry.title: €227,700 · 1927 brick house with a three-season room and pergola garden in Manitowoc, Wisconsin
entry.summary: Manitowoc, Wisconsin. 146 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 87. Asking US$249,900 (about €227,700) for a 1927 brick house of about 146 m² on the north side of Manitowoc, a port town on Lake Michigan. It has four bedrooms, two bathrooms, hardwood floors and its original wood trim and doors. A bright three-season room with wood ceiling opens off the front, and an upstairs porch faces the sunsets. The garden is the star: brick paths, tiered beds, raspberry canes and a patio under a grape-covered pergola, plus a detached two-car garage. The photos show a spotless, cared-for home. Yearly property tax US$2,911, no HOA fee.

entry.title: €155,000 · Restored medieval hamlet home with two en-suite bedrooms near Spoleto, Umbria
entry.summary: La Torretta, Spoleto, Umbria. 73 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 75. A recently renovated house on three levels with its own entrance, in a small medieval hamlet 5 km from Spoleto. The ground floor is a living room with kitchen, and each upper floor has a bedroom with a fireplace and its own bathroom. Finishes are modern resin floors set against vaulted ceilings and rough stone-effect walls, and the advert calls the condition perfect. With it come a 5 m2 laundry, an 11 m2 room with bathroom that still needs work, and two small plots of 126 and 63 m2. The commercial area is 73 m2. Asking 155,000 euros.

entry.title: €198,400 · Refurbished period townhouse with a double garage in Lack village, County Fermanagh
entry.summary: Lack, County Fermanagh, Northern Ireland. 107 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. Asking £172,500 (about €198,400) for a 107 m² traditional end-terrace townhouse that has been fully and carefully refurbished, keeping its original character. The lounge opens to a contemporary kitchen and dining area, there are three bedrooms with an en suite to the main one, plus a stylish family bathroom. Oil central heating and PVC double glazing. Outside it has a generous end site with parking, a yard and a large double garage. Photos show green hills beside the house and a bright, well kept interior. Rates £702 a year. EPC E52.

entry.title: €195,400 · Renovated two-bedroom end terrace with garage in historic Greyabbey, Northern Ireland
entry.summary: Greyabbey, Northern Ireland. 80 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. Asking £169,950 (about €195,400) for an 80 m² end-terrace house in the heart of historic Greyabbey, comprehensively renovated within the last five years. Downstairs there is a bright open-plan living and dining room, a modern kitchen with integrated appliances and a WC. Upstairs are two double bedrooms, the main one with an en suite, plus a family shower room. A substantial garage and workshop sits behind the house, with street parking in front. It is turnkey and sold as a home or holiday base; it is run as a holiday let at present. Rates £1,299 a year.

entry.title: €188,000 · Renovated stone house on the Canal du Nivernais in Champvert, Burgundy
entry.summary: Champvert, Nièvre, Burgundy. 160 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 79. A stone village house with direct access to the towpath of the Canal du Nivernais, renovated over the years and sold as needing no work. About 160 m2 for 188,000 euros, so under 1,200 euros per m2. There is a 50 m2 living room with a pellet stove, a fitted kitchen with an island, two large bedrooms (one en suite) and a 30 m2 study in the former stables. The roof was redone in 2024, gas central heating dates from 2017 and the energy rating is C. Garden of 1,225 m2, 5 minutes from Decize. Property tax 890 euros a year.

entry.title: €155,000 · Detached town house with three en-suite bedrooms in old Iglesias, Sardinia
entry.summary: Iglesias, Sardinia. 104 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 79. A detached house in the historic centre of Iglesias in south-west Sardinia, about 15 minutes by car from the Sulcis coast and the beach at Masua, according to the advert. About 104 m2 with three double bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, plus a living room and kitchenette. The owner lists new windows and doors, heat pumps for heating and cooling, carpenter-made furniture and a wrought-iron staircase. Sold fully furnished and equipped, ready to move in. Light from two street fronts. Listed by the owner.

entry.title: €227,700 · Move-in ready three-bedroom house a short walk from downtown Bedford, Virginia
entry.summary: Bedford, Virginia. 109 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. Asking US$249,996 (about €227,700) for a freshly updated 1960 house of about 109 m² in Bedford, a small town in the foothills of Virginia's Blue Ridge, within a short walk of the shops and restaurants downtown. It has three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, hardwood floors and a bright white kitchen with stainless appliances. The main costly items are recent: the roof was replaced in 2020, the heating and cooling system is four years old and the fridge one. Outside there is a lawn, a covered patio and a second sitting area under a metal canopy, plus a storage shed. Yearly property tax US$1,025, no HOA fee.

entry.title: €249,900 · Renovated 112 m² town-centre flat with energy rating A in Marche-en-Famenne
entry.summary: Marche-en-Famenne, Luxembourg province. 112 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A large flat of about 112 m² in the heart of Marche-en-Famenne, renovated in 2017 and described as ready to move into. It has an entrance hall with separate WC, a living room, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen, a shower room, one bedroom and an office or dressing room that could serve as a second bedroom. Energy rating A, compliant electrics, oil-fired underfloor heating and a heat-recovery ventilation system. Photos show a modern grey kitchen, a walk-in shower and big windows. Building charges are not stated.

entry.title: €148,000 · Stone farmhouse with four bedrooms and 3 hectares of land near Gubbio, Umbria
entry.summary: Gubbio, Perugia, Umbria. 110 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A seismically reinforced stone farmhouse portion in a sunny, secluded spot 20 minutes from medieval Gubbio, with its own entrance and about 3 hectares of land. The 110 m2 first floor holds a large kitchen, a living room with a fireplace, four double bedrooms and two bathrooms. Below are another 110 m2 of storerooms that could become a second flat. There is also a barn with a wood-fired oven and a tool shed. The photos show a clean stone exterior and plain, tidy rooms. At 148,000 euros this is a lot of house and land for central Italy.

entry.title: €223,300 · Renovated 1889 Victorian with a deep front porch in Lynchburg, Virginia
entry.summary: Lynchburg, Virginia. 289 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 93. Asking US$245,000 (about €223,300) for a renovated 1889 Victorian of about 289 m² in Lynchburg, a historic city on the James River at the foot of the Blue Ridge. It keeps its high ceilings, tall windows, hardwood floors and ornate carved fireplace mantels, and the white kitchen has stainless appliances. The main bedroom suite and the laundry are on the ground floor. Outside there is a deep covered front porch, a planted front garden and the original carriage house for storage. The metal roof and blue siding look well kept in the photos. Yearly property tax US$1,638, no HOA fee.

entry.title: €115,000 · Renovated hillside house with big terraces near Castellino Tanaro, Piedmont
entry.summary: Viorno, Castellino Tanaro, Piedmont. 180 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 86. A former barn turned into a home in the small hamlet of Viorno, about 2 km from Castellino Tanaro in the hills of Cuneo province. The advert lists the work done: new roof in 2010, all wiring renewed, plumbing replaced in 2015, modern double-glazed windows, new shutters, replastered walls and a new terrace in 2019. About 180 m2 with a dining room and open kitchen, TV room, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, plus a tavern with fireplace, two cellars and a garage. Wood stoves, no central heating. Described as in excellent condition and ready to move in, at roughly 640 euros per m2.

entry.title: €79,500 · Four-bedroom house from 2004 in Misaki on the Miura peninsula, Kanagawa
entry.summary: Misaki-machi Moroiso, Miura, Kanagawa. 83 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A two-storey wooden house finished in December 2004 in Moroiso, on the Misaki side of the Miura peninsula in Kanagawa. 82.8 m² with four rooms plus a living, dining and kitchen area, storage in every room, a bathroom with a window and a heater, and a balcony, on a 123 m² freehold plot with parking. From Misakiguchi station it is a 12 minute bus ride and a 3 minute walk. The owner still lives there and the handover date is open to discussion. Asking ¥13,900,000 (about €79,500), under €1,000/m².

entry.title: €197,000 · Newly renovated two-bed flat with sea-view terrace in Castellaro, Liguria
entry.summary: Castellaro, Imperia, Liguria. 76 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. A two-bedroom flat of about 76 m2 in a small building 300 metres from the hill village of Castellaro, freshly renovated and ready to move into, with no condominium fees. The terrace has wide views over olive groves to the sea, which also shows from the bedroom windows. Inside are a living room with a new kitchen, a main bedroom with walk-in wardrobe and en suite, a second bathroom and a laundry area. Heating and cooling come from inverter units, with double glazing and electric shutters. A 43 m2 garage below can be bought separately. Asking 197,000 euros.

entry.title: €178,500 · Breton stone house with a conservatory near the Térénez beaches in Plouezoc'h
entry.summary: Plouezoc'h, Finistère, Brittany. 88 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A granite and slate Breton house 5 minutes from the Térénez beaches and sailing school. It has 88 m² plus a 20 m² glazed conservatory along the garden side. Downstairs are a kitchen with dining space, a living and dining room, a bedroom and a bathroom, so single-level living is possible. Upstairs are two more bedrooms and an open area for an office. The plot is about 520 m² with parking. The kitchen is modern, but the upstairs rooms keep old wallpaper and the bathroom is dated, so plan to redecorate. Energy rating E.

entry.title: €214,100 · Updated four-bedroom house with a new kitchen in La Crosse, Wisconsin
entry.summary: La Crosse, Wisconsin. 127 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 88. Asking US$235,000 (about €214,100) for a house of about 127 m² in La Crosse, a university city on the Mississippi River in western Wisconsin. Built in 1889, it has been updated from top to bottom: a new kitchen with white shaker units, subway tiles and a gas range, stylish new bathrooms including a marble-look shower, light wood-look floors and an open living and dining area. The advert lists four bedrooms. There is a front porch, a fenced side lawn and room behind for a patio or a future garage. Yearly property tax US$2,903, no HOA fee.

entry.title: €140,000 · Updated character house with a wood stove and workshop in Liverpool, Nova Scotia
entry.summary: Liverpool, Nova Scotia. 155 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. Asking C$220,000 (about €140,000) for a 1935 house of about 155 m², a few minutes from downtown Liverpool, a harbour town on Nova Scotia's South Shore about 90 minutes from Halifax. Much of the work is done: refinished original wood floors, a renovated kitchen with custom cabinets, wooden worktops and a cast-iron farmhouse sink, replastered and painted walls, updated wiring and plumbing, new gutters and a certified wood stove in the newly insulated living room. There is a bathroom with shower downstairs, a new half bath upstairs and a flexible two-plus-one bedroom layout. Outside are a large workshop and a stocked woodshed.

entry.title: €139,500 · Two-bedroom 85 m² pool-view condo from 2012 near Khao Takiab beach, Hua Hin
entry.summary: Khao Takiab, Hua Hin, Prachuap Khiri Khan. 85 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. An 85.3 m² condo with two bedrooms and two bathrooms on the 6th floor of The Seacraze, a low-rise building from 2012 a short walk from Khao Takiab beach in Hua Hin. A patio looks over the large swimming pool and the flat is sold furnished. The complex has a pool, gym, kids room, key-card access, CCTV and 24-hour security. The unit is offered under the foreign quota, so a foreigner can own it freehold. Asking 5,200,000 baht (about €139,500), roughly €1,640/m². Maintenance: 45 baht per m² a month (about 3,840 baht or €103). Transfer costs shared 50/50.

entry.title: €104,600 · Refreshed three-bedroom house from 2009 with parking for two in Nasushiobara, Tochigi
entry.summary: Higashi-Mishima, Nasushiobara, Tochigi. 98 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 75. A two-storey wooden house built in July 2009 in Higashi-Mishima, Nasushiobara, in northern Tochigi. 97.9 m² with three bedrooms and a living, dining and kitchen room, balconies on both floors and storage in every room, on a 192 m² freehold plot with parking for two cars. The seller has just renewed the wallpaper, cleaned the kitchen and bathrooms and changed the locks, and the empty house can be handed over at once. A primary school is 600 m away and a supermarket 450 m. The buyer must fit a new water heater. Asking ¥18,290,000 (about €104,600).

entry.title: €180,000 · Renovated country house with garden and vineyard views near Acqui Terme
entry.summary: Acqui Terme, Piedmont. 200 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. A large house about 2 km from the spa town of Acqui Terme, free on three sides and largely renovated according to the advert. About 200 m2 on two floors: entrance hall, living room, kitchen with a French window to the private garden and a dining room under a brick vault on the ground floor, with bedrooms, a bathroom, a laundry and a balcony with open views upstairs. The photos show a paved garden terrace and vineyards behind. Independent gas central heating, a fireplace and parking space. Around 900 euros per m2 for a move-in home in the Monferrato wine hills.

entry.title: €232,400 · Well-kept 1899 house with a new double garage near Chester Park in Duluth
entry.summary: Duluth, Minnesota. 148 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 88. Asking US$255,000 (about €232,400) for a house of about 148 m² in Duluth, the hilly port city on Lake Superior. Built in 1899, it has had its furnace, roof, windows, siding, doors, wiring and plumbing all replaced since 2011. Downstairs are spacious living and dining rooms with hardwood floors, a white kitchen with stainless appliances and a door to the back deck, and a half bath with laundry. The three bedrooms and an updated full bathroom are upstairs. There is a newer two-car garage plus an extra parking space, and Chester Park and downtown are close. Yearly property tax US$3,368, no HOA fee.

entry.title: €180,000 · Renovated country house with panoramic porch and olive grove near Arpino, Lazio
entry.summary: Arpino, Frosinone, Lazio. 147 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. A recently renovated single-storey country house on the hills around Arpino, within walking distance of the historic town. The photos show new bathrooms, white walls, wood floors and a large covered porch with a beamed wooden roof looking over olive trees and mountains. It has a fireplace, a pellet stove, air conditioning, new double glazing and metal shutters, plus a cellar. The garden around the house is fenced and gated, and the plot of about 11,751 m2 is planted with olives. About 147 m2 for 180,000 euros, under 1,250 euros per m2.

entry.title: €159,000 · Renovated village house with energy rating B in the centre of Riez, Verdon
entry.summary: Riez, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence, Provence. 91 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A 91 m2 village house on a small square in the centre of Riez, fully renovated to current standards and rated B for energy, which is rare for an old Provençal house. It has two kitchens and living areas over the lower floors, two bedrooms (one with its own shower), a bathroom, reversible air conditioning in three zones and about 50 m2 of cellars. A small courtyard behind a wrought iron gate fits a table. Shops, schools, a hospital and two weekly markets are in the village, and Lake Sainte-Croix and the Verdon gorges are minutes away. About 1,750 euros per m2.

entry.title: €68,000 · Renovated red wooden villa with wide valley views near Fränsta, Västernorrland
entry.summary: Rombäck, Fränsta, Västernorrland. 116 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 90. Asking 750,000 SEK (about €68,000) for a 116 m² two-storey wooden house from 1915 on a 2,820 m² plot, under €600 per m². The advert says you can move straight in: kitchen, bathroom and surfaces were renovated in 2016, the wiring was recently updated and fibre broadband is connected. Downstairs are a kitchen with island and old wood stove, a dining room, a living room with fireplace and a tiled stove, and a shower room. Upstairs are two bedrooms. A garage and barn give storage, and the house looks out over a wide green valley. Running costs 36,085 SEK a year.

entry.title: €179,000 · Renovated furnished cottage on 860 m2 of land in Lajes do Pico, Azores
entry.summary: Silveira, Lajes do Pico, Azores. 84 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A fully renovated stone cottage in Silveira, 3 km from the old whaling town of Lajes on Pico island, sold furnished and equipped. 84 m2 of built area on two floors with a bedroom, living room, new fitted kitchen and modern shower room, plus air conditioning and fibre internet. Energy class C. It stands on 860 m2 of land with parking and fruit trees, all classed as urban, and the advert says about 388 m2 more could be built subject to permission. School 1 km away, Pico airport 30 minutes. Only one bedroom.

entry.title: €120,000 · Detached house with a 350 m2 garden and garage in San Lorenzo in Campo, Marche
entry.summary: San Lorenzo in Campo, Le Marche. 130 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. An early 1900s detached house in the centre of San Lorenzo in Campo, a hill village in Pesaro and Urbino province, about 25 km from the Marotta beaches. The renovated, furnished first floor (65 m2) has a kitchen with dining area, two bedrooms and a bathroom; the ground floor (65 m2) holds a garage and two storage rooms. The owner lists wall and ceiling insulation, new floors, exterior painting and certified wiring, plumbing and boiler. A fenced south-facing garden of about 350 m2, a covered pergola and a carport. Pharmacy, shops and schools are a short walk away.

entry.title: €189,000 · Move-in ready 1700s stone village house of 180 m² near La Rochefoucauld, Charente
entry.summary: Yvrac-et-Malleyrand, Charente. 180 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. About 180 m² of old stone house for €189,000, roughly €1,050 per m², and the advert says it is ready to move into. The ground floor has three rooms of over 30 m² each: a living room, a large beamed kitchen and a bedroom with its own bathroom, so you can live on one level. Upstairs are a 34 m² bedroom with a private bathroom, a 23 m² office, a mezzanine and a terrace. Exposed stone, old beams and stoves. Small easy garden, carport and workshop. The village is 5 km from La Rochefoucauld and 30 km from Angoulême TGV station. Energy rating D.

entry.title: €195,000 · Two-storey stone house facing the Libyan Sea in Koutsounari, south Crete
entry.summary: Koutsounari, Ierapetra, Crete. 88 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. A two-storey stone house with open views of the Libyan Sea, 1.3 km from Long Beach on the south coast of Crete. A stone-paved courtyard under a pergola faces the sea, and inside stairs lead up to a large view terrace. The living room has wood beams and a fireplace, and there is a separate traditional kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms, all tiled. Hot water comes from a solar panel, and there is parking outside. Shops and tavernas open all year are a 3-minute drive away. About 88 m2 for 195,000 euros.

entry.title: €195,800 · Updated 1886 house with a fenced garden and an oversized garage in La Crosse, Wisconsin
entry.summary: La Crosse, Wisconsin. 142 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 90. Asking US$214,900 (about €195,800) for a three-bedroom house of about 142 m² in La Crosse, a university city on the Mississippi in western Wisconsin. Built in 1886, it has had recent updates: fresh paint in many rooms, new central air conditioning, a new water heater and a new deck. The front opens into a bright enclosed porch room, and the galley kitchen has wood-look floors and plenty of cupboards. The fully fenced back garden is neatly landscaped, with a patio and fire pit, and the oversized garage holds three or more cars plus storage. One bathroom. Yearly property tax US$3,565, no HOA fee.
